answer_1.quote: We run extensive experiments across representative knowledge-intensive tasks: open-domain QA (Natural Questions Open; TriviaQA unfiltered), fact verification (FaVIQ), and knowledge grounded dialogue (Wizard of Wikipedia).
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for question answering, utterances for dialogue generation, and support/refute labels for fact verification.

answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we use Exact Match (EM) as our primary metric.
